items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 37:1
items.html: The essential existence of the vessels was made from the light of the look, as above in Item 128. However, their coarseness and their form were made by the reflected light that descends from the Ozen, Hotem and Peh downward, as above in Item 129. (Chapter 11, Item 7)
